user.title: First Words
user.description: Files are saved on a network share mounted in Home Assistant (Settings > System > Storage, usage: Media). The share must be mounted before setup.

data.storage_name: What to call the storage in the app

data_description.people: The name is matched to each person's Home Assistant user; the label is what 'Who heard it' shows, e.g. 'Alex: Mama'.
data_description.mount_path: Where Home Assistant mounted the share, e.g. /media/FirstWords. Saving is refused whenever this is not a live mount.
data_description.storage_name: Shown in the app, e.g. 'Saved on the NAS'.
data_description.offsite_note: Shown under the Save button if the share is backed up elsewhere, e.g. 'copied to Google Drive every night'.

error.not_mounted: Nothing is mounted there. Add the share in Settings > System > Storage first.
error.bad_folder: Use a single folder name, without slashes.

abort.already_configured: First Words is already set up.

data.storage_name: What to call the storage in the app

error.not_mounted: Nothing is mounted there. Add the share in Settings > System > Storage first.
error.bad_folder: Use a single folder name, without slashes.

export_zip.name: Make a backup zip
export_zip.description: Zips every clip with a CSV and JSON copy of the log into the share's exports folder.

make_keepsake.name: Make a printable keepsake
make_keepsake.description: Writes a printable HTML page, oldest word first, into the share's exports folder.

import_json.name: Import from the Apps Script version
import_json.description: Imports a first-words.json, or the backup .zip containing one. Words already present are skipped.

source.name: Source
source.description: Path to first-words.json or the backup .zip, as Home Assistant sees it.

clips.name: Clips
clips.description: Optional folder or .zip holding the audio clips, if they are not in the source zip.
